title: orobanche hesperina
intro: Orobanche hesperina, commonly known as the Mediterranean broomrape, is a parasitic plant that attaches itself to the roots of host plants, such as Thymus and Teucrium species. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Orobanche hesperina include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenoid alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
